name: GET /api/leadflow/coverage/console - rota and the gap detector
description:
Schedules and on-call from sdk-coverage, plus a LOCAL gap detector.

THE GAP DETECTOR ALWAYS ANSWERS, even when the coverage service is down. Unowned active leads and an unreleased overnight queue are computed locally, because an outage in the tool that finds unowned leads is precisely when leads go unowned — a console that goes blank during the incident it exists to surface is worse than no console. QA: measured live, reporting zero unowned in America/Chicago.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
